key_moments: 45' Goal: Folarin Balogun opens the scoring for the United States just before halftime.
64' Red Card: Folarin Balogun (United States) is sent off for a tackle on Tarik Muharemović, leaving the USA with 10 men.
82' Goal: Malik Tillman extends the United States' lead with a sensational free kick, securing their advancement.

standout_performers.reason: Scored the crucial opening goal, demonstrating clinical finishing.
Scored a decisive free-kick goal to seal the victory while the team was down to 10 men.

matches.tactical_summary: The United States took a vital lead just before halftime, showcasing aggressive pressing. Despite playing with 10 men for much of the second half, the USMNT displayed tremendous defensive discipline and secured their progression with a late free-kick.

narrative: The United States secured a hard-fought 2-0 victory over Bosnia in the Round of 32, advancing to the next stage of the World Cup. Their resilient performance, including playing with ten men for a significant period, showcased their determination in a dramatic knockout clash.
next_round_notes: Folarin Balogun (United States) will be suspended for the next Round of 16 match due to his red card.
